name: step-ca
summary: Private certificate authority for automated X.509 and SSH certificate issuance and lifecycle management.
why_it_matters: step-ca preserves useful private-PKI capability knowledge, but there is no current validated workflow that justifies actively maintaining it as a supported resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs internal certificate issuance or renewal.
Operators want private PKI for services, devices, or SSH access.
The workflow depends on automated certificate lifecycle management.

platform_support.notes: The CA can run in containers, but useful support depends on key custody, trust distribution, and TLS integration across the environment.

prerequisites: Defined certificate policy and renewal workflow
implementation_notes: Promotion should begin with a narrow internal certificate workflow.
Keep CA operation separate from application-specific TLS automation.
Do not imply safe PKI operations without end-to-end validation.
operational_notes: Backup and root/intermediate key handling are critical.
Validation should cover issuance and trust verification, not just startup.
Certificate lifecycle mistakes have broad blast radius.
risks: PKI support is high-trust and easy to get wrong.
A thin wrapper can be more dangerous than no wrapper.
